_note: Business-model rewrite of design/marketing/Services Landing.dc.html at /services-landing. The design moved from an escrow marketplace to an introductions platform (you hire and pay your specialist directly; we never touch the money), so the hero subcopy, the how-it-works lead and steps, the categories heading, the third benefit card and the payments FAQ all changed. seeds/content_copy.json / content_blocks.json were extracted from the superseded revision and still re-seed the escrow wording. `delete` drops the two blocks the design renamed — the 'Delivered via escrow' step and the 'Escrow-backed & vetted' benefit — so the stale extracted rows can't linger beside their replacements.
